title: AI NEXUS – Futuristic Seminar on Artificial Intelligence
excerpt:
All Saints Public School, Adoor, through its Science Club and Research Club, jointly organizes AI NEXUS, a futuristic seminar on Artificial Intelligence.

The seminar will explore the impact of AI on education, healthcare, employment, human intelligence, science and technology, and responsible AI development.

Join our young and prospective scientists as they share ideas, explore innovations and discuss the future of Artificial Intelligence.

**Date:** 15 September 2026  
**Time:** 11:15 AM  
**Venue:** School Auditorium

Explore Innovations. Inspire Yourself. Be Future Ready!
